name: SettingsForm
title: Blocks/Settings/SettingsForm
summary: A settings form and its save strategy, one variant per strategy. SaveAll, the default (a form that is one logical unit has one save): account-level settings as `Item` rows saved as one unit, a page body for ConsoleLayout (the layout owns the shell and the main landmark): the form column opening with a small page heading, topic sections each a `Subheader` (an h2) over a flush `Card` of rows, and one full-bleed sticky footer with Discard and Save, both disabled until the form differs from what was saved (dirty tracking through `useUnsavedChanges`); a successful save confirms with a `Profile saved.` toast and a rejected one shows an error toast with Retry, the entries kept (SaveError); Profile is the example, with General (Full name, Email), Preferences (Timezone, Language) and Notifications (Product updates), and Full name and Email flag only after Save is pressed. SavePerGroup splits the page into topic groups whose `Card` footers each carry a secondary Save for that group only. SavePerCard splits a long configuration page into titled cards, each with an info `Alert`, its stacked fields and its own Save beside an optional docs `Link`. Profile is the full profile page of a signed-in account, and the layout every account settings page follows: seven `SettingsGroup`s of flush `Card`s of rows with the unsaved-changes `SaveBar`, MFA linked to `account/account-mfa-settings`, and Delete account behind a type-to-confirm `ConfirmDialog`; ProfileLoading and ProfileError are its first load and its load failure. Saving one group or card disables just its own fieldset; the others stay editable, and each save confirms with a toast. Built from `PageHeader`, `Subheader`, `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`, `SaveBar`, `Card`, `Item`, `Alert`, `Field`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Tag`, `Link`, `FieldError`, `ConfirmDialog`, `Skeleton` and `Button`.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save is in flight: the whole fieldset is disabled, Discard is disabled and Save shows its loading state.

variants.name: SaveError
variants.summary: The server rejects the save: Save stops loading, an error toast says the profile was not saved and that the changes are kept, with Retry; the form stays dirty with every entry in place.

variants.name: SavePerGroup
variants.summary: A settings page split into topic groups that each save on their own: a page heading, then one section per topic, each a `Subheader` over a flush `Card` of `Item` rows whose footer carries a secondary Save for that group only. Saving one group disables just its own fieldset; the other stays editable. Preferences is the example, with General (Full name, Language) and Notifications (Product updates, Security alerts). Built from `PageHeader`, `Subheader`, `SettingsRow`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneGroup
variants.summary: General is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its rows are disabled, while Notifications stays editable and can be saved on its own.

variants.name: SavePerCard
variants.summary: A long configuration page split into titled cards that each own their save: a page heading, then one `Card` per topic with an info `Alert`, stacked label-and-control fields inside a fieldset, and a footer whose secondary Save commits that card alone, beside an optional docs `Link`. Project settings is the example, with Preview Toolbar and Deployment Protection. Built from `PageHeader`, `Card`, `Alert`, `Field`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneCard
variants.summary: Preview Toolbar is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its selects are disabled, while Deployment Protection stays editable.

variants.name: Profile
variants.summary: The profile page of a signed-in account: a small page heading over seven stacked `SettingsGroup`s (General, Company information, Address information, Login settings, Source control, Appearance, Danger zone), each a flush `Card` of rows, with the `SaveBar` that rises once a saved field changes. Account name comes filled; Billing emails starts empty and is required; both are checked on Save. Requiring MFA lives in `account/account-mfa-settings`, linked from the Login settings row; source-control actions open the provider; Delete account asks in a `ConfirmDialog` that takes the account name typed. A save that fails with no field to blame raises an error toast with Retry and keeps the changes.

variants.name: ProfileLoading
variants.summary: The profile's first load: three cards of Skeleton rows in place of the sections, the heading kept.

variants.name: ProfileError
variants.summary: The account did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the profile sections; Retry loads them.
